pick.headline: American hostage David Jacobsen freed in Beirut
pick.summary: On 2 November 1986 Islamic Jihad released David Jacobsen, director of the American University Hospital in Beirut, after some seventeen months in captivity.
pick.significance: Jacobsen's release was a product of the secret US arms sales to Iran. Within days a Lebanese magazine exposed the dealings, opening the Iran-Contra affair.
pick.fbis: The Middle East & South Asia review of 3 November 1986 relayed AFP's report of Islamic Jihad's release statement, which held the US government "entirely responsible" if it failed to pursue a solution to the hostage issue.
